# Marionette

Start here when using the installed package or this repository to build an application.

- [Quick start](docs/quick-start.md): one complete first screen with managed rows, selection, DOM events, and cleanup.
- [Task routing](docs/agents.md): choose one starting guide for an existing task.
- [Focused retrieval](docs/agent-retrieval.md): read a known guide or search matching installed sections; optional MCP uses the same contract.
- [Forms](docs/forms-and-accessibility.md): retain focused input while updating derived display and saving.
- [Compact contracts](docs/compact-reference.md): ownership, readiness, teardown, delegated event targets, and triggerMethod dispatch.
- [API index](docs/readme.md): individual reference pages.
- [Migration from v4](upgradeGuide.md).

Use the relevant task guide directly, or the quick start when an API introduction helps.
Search docs/*.md for API guidance; test/fixtures/ holds executable doc examples; config/diagnostics/ holds diagnostic codes.
The installed package version is in package.json. Its documentation provenance is
in docs-manifest.json. This file is a discovery index, not maintainer instructions.

For a focused API lookup from your application directory (Node 24+):

```sh
node node_modules/marionette/dist/agent-skill/scripts/docs.mjs --project . --search 'getUI'
```

Use a returned section ID with `--section` on the same helper. It ships inside the
package; no skill installation or MCP connection is required. See
[focused retrieval](docs/agent-retrieval.md) for hoisted package paths and provenance.
